h1: Drupal maintenance, updates and security patches
overview: We bring your Drupal site up to date and make it safe. We take a backup, copy the site to staging, apply core and module updates, apply any pending security patches, fix what breaks, and then update the live site once you approve. You get a short report listing every change. This is a fixed starter round. If you want regular monthly care after that, we quote it separately.

faq: This is one fixed round of updates and fixes. If you want us to repeat it every month, we quote monthly care separately once we know your site.
My site is very old, can you still update it?
Usually yes, within limits. Drupal 7 has reached the end of its support, so updating it means moving it to a newer version, which is our migration service.
What if an update breaks something?
That is why we test on a copy. If something breaks, we fix it on staging or tell you what a module needs. The live site only changes after you approve.
Normally only for a few minutes while the live update runs. We agree a quiet time with you, and take a backup first so we can roll back if anything goes wrong.
